core_obligations: Show that the ring extension A_J to A is finite, using the finiteness of the power series extension over a finite extension of the base field (proof lines 11536-11540).
Verify property (1): every p-th power of an element of A already lies in A_J (proof lines 11544-11546).

Verify property (2): an element of K contained in every K_J lies in the p-th powers, by applying derivations in the power series variables and a derivation of the base field and using that A is a domain (proof lines 11546-11560).
Verify property (3): the family is filtering downwards, by the containment K_{J union J'} inside the intersection of K_J and K_{J'} (proof lines 11560-11561).
proof_roadmap: Finiteness of the ring extensions (proof lines 11536-11540).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a filtering family of subfields of the fraction field of a power series ring over a field of characteristic p, indexed by finite subsets of a p-basis, and verifies the three hypotheses of the intersection statement of the same block; it also records that the corresponding ring extensions are finite. The proof is a 26-line argument: finiteness of the ring extension comes from the finiteness of the power series extension after a finite extension of the base, and then the three properties are checked one by one, the second being the substantial one, where an element contained in every K_J is shown to lie in the p-th powers by applying derivations with respect to the power series variables and a derivation of the base field and using that the ring is a domain. The derivation argument is carried out in detail.
